steps.text: It was just like a dream.
She traversed a great, long journey, crossing mountains and ridges in the ice and snow, reaching an endless field of rice at the end of the road.
The rich stalks glimmered like gold. She did not know who had planted them here, or why they grew so prosperously.
How wonderful.
'Then, stay here.'
She hears a voice calling out to her.
No... No.
She remembers her unfinished business, and the place she must return to.
She picks up a stalk of rice.
A vague figure waves a hoe around, burying seeds in a plot.

steps.name: Busy Farmer
steps.text: You're back?! Thank goodness, everyone was waiting for you!

steps.name: Busy Farmer
steps.text: You were gone so long. Did the trip go smoothly? Did you find the crops you were searching for?

steps.name: Busy Farmer
steps.text: Laoshi... Are you alright? You look a bit...

steps.name: Busy Farmer
steps.text: Wh-What is this?!

steps.name: Busy Farmer
steps.text: Help! Someone!

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: Xiaohe? You're still here?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I found it...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: The contamination... It didn't come with the flood. The source must be underground.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: If we gather the Tianshi Bureaus, it might not be too late to start researching now!

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: There's no need to bother with that.

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: We've already decided to abandon these lands...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: It won't take that much time! Give me maybe two or three days, and I should be able to pinpoint the source of the contamination! There must be a solution!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Every bit of land here in Dahuang was hard-won. We haven't put in anywhere near that much effort yet, so how could we just give up—

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: It's not just a few plots of land. It's the entire city.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: Everyone is to move into the core city and follow it east, leaving behind all the other fields here by tomorrow.

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: The other Tianshis are getting everyone together to prepare for the move. This is what matters most right now... You should go help them.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Whose... idea was this?

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: Who else could order the entire city relocated?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Why...?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: All these experimental fields, and these newly-planted crops...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: This has already been a famine year. If we give up on these crops, how many more people are going to go hungry?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: It'll be just like it used to be...

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: We've tried our best.

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: Evacuate the people as soon as possible. Establish post-disaster countermeasures in advance. You are a Tianshi, so have your priorities straight at a time like this—

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Is the legend true...?

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: What nonsense are you spouting now...?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: What's hidden in the permafrost on the north bank of the river? It's those things that contaminated our land, isn't it?

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: Just treat it like any other Catastrophe.

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: There've been so many things we couldn't protect over the years...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: The people aren't just going to leave.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: This is our land. Nobody's going to leave until we figure out exactly what's going on.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: If Shennong could keep these enemies from our homes, then so can we.
Is it an illusion?
The vast fields in front of him instantly turn empty and barren.
No, it's not that the fields have turned barren. Rather, Heaven and earth are being invaded by a foreign space. It warps beyond the recognition of any soul.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: What's going on over there?!

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: It's too late...

steps.name: Terrified Farmer
steps.text: Shu, what in tarnation was that...?

steps.name: Terrified Farmer
steps.text: Laoshi... is she sick? How did she become like this?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Give her... a proper burial.
The thin, emaciated body falls to the cold, hard ground, a small pack of seeds tucked in the pocket of her flimsy shirt.

steps.name: Terrified Farmer
steps.text: Are these the seeds she brought back? Did she manage to find the legendary seeds?

steps.name: Terrified Farmer
steps.text: Our harvests have been terrible the last couple of years. Maybe with this packet of seeds, there's some hope after all.

steps.name: Terrified Farmer
steps.text: Let's take it back...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: How'd the demonic contamination end up underground?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Isn't the Chamber of Heaven's Designs standing guard outside? How did the contaminants get past the old one and make their way inside?

steps.name: Tianshi of the Chamber
steps.text: Based on current observations, the contamination here likely existed long before the Chamber of Heaven's Designs did.

steps.name: Tianshi of the Chamber
steps.text: The underground area here is already highly contaminated.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: But, the demonic influence here hasn't spread in all these years. Was it because of her?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: But, why now of all times...? Could she have...?

steps.name: Tianshi of the Chamber
steps.text: The Chamber has likely already determined the source of this calamity. But, the top priority remains dealing with the crisis at hand.

steps.name: Tianshi of the Chamber
steps.text: The impact of this demonic catastrophe is unprecedented, and well beyond the scope of any of the Chamber's plans.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: That's clear from the fact that you Chamber Tianshis actually called me up... So, what options do we still have?

steps.name: Tianshi of the Chamber
steps.text: Have all the Chamber's forces on the north bank withdraw, and at the same time, have the demon defense line pull back fifty kilometers to the south.

steps.name: Tianshi of the Chamber
steps.text: Abandon all plots, and evacuate to the core city. After that, we'll need your help activating the core city's defenses, and re-establishing a defensive line using the core city as a barrier.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: This plan doesn't tally up how many people are going to be sacrificed.

steps.name: Tianshi of the Chamber
steps.text: Demonic taint is not like any ordinary calamity. It must be nipped in the bud.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I've never seen Yan make such a rough call before. Who ordered it?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Was it your big boss, the great and unknowable Old Tianshi?

steps.name: Tianshi of the Chamber
steps.text: Just do as you're told, and don't ask too many questions.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What are you looking at?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Why would she do this?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: She probably doesn't want to leave though...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: If the demons had already contaminated the land all the way back then... She's been single-handedly suppressing it all this time.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: A thousand years... What would it feel like to have your consciousness gnawed by demons for a thousand years...?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Shu... Good grief...

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: There's no other way?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: There's nothing we can do. You can't whisk everyone away inside a painting, and I can't build a castle out of thin air to carry everyone off either.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Then, what about her?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What do you mean...?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Surely she would've known that this day would eventually come?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: The question is... where is she now?
Crying.
The cries came from far away. Babies wailing, old people sobbing. Even the crops in the field are mourning.
Just like the scene from forty years ago.
That was another famine year.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: You're... from the Sui Regulator?

a.text: Your orders are to farm Dahuang. Catastrophes have been frequent in recent years, and harvests have failed year after year. As a proxy, you clearly have the ability to save these crops, yet you've chosen to stand by and do nothing?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: The people can't do what I can.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: If I save them, the people will only think about how to make this 'miracle' happen again.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: But, I can't save them every time... One day, I will be gone.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: And when that time comes, the power I wield now... will become nothing more than the 'root of evil' that harms others.

a.text: Is there nothing you can do?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: There really isn't much that I can do... other than write down my experiences and pass them down to future generations.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Once the hard years are over, there will be bountiful years to follow. People have always had to rely on themselves to survive.

a.text: But how am I to believe that by remaining here, you're doing something good for Yan and its people?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: How long are you staying here?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Wait for this year's harvest. You'll see.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: By the way, have you ever worked the land before?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: It's planting season now, and everyone has their hands full. Would you mind lending me a hand?

a.text: I vaguely remember that the crops grew particularly well that year.
The plowed rice piled up into little hills, and the farmers said they wouldn't need to worry about Catastrophe for the next few years.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: You're smiling?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Are you still going to write me up in your report to the Sui Regulator?

a.text: Are you going to stay here forever? Stay here and help us...
With you here, everyone feels safe.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: I used to have a friend just like you.

a.text: Now, there truly is no other way.
Just once... I'm begging you just this one time.
Can you please save the people here, only once?
You promised me that you'd stay here forever...

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: Shu...
The room is empty.
A warm bowl of soup still sits on the table.

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: I see... You've already...
The rain starts to fall.

steps.name: Farmer by the Fields
steps.text: It's raining?
The farmer looks up to see a thin cloud covering the crescent moon in the sky. Shortly thereafter, a few drops of cold rain fall.

steps.name: Farmer by the Fields
steps.text: Who is that...?
In the distance, someone walks deeper into the fields.
She walks across the barren fields, and wherever her feet fall, small verdant patches follow.
'Wei, where are you going?'
She does not respond, and simply continues to walk forward.
She walks further and further, until her figure disappears altogether with a thunderclap.
Unlike the heavy rain from just a few days earlier, the rain right now is so tender and fine.
As the rain falls, all the cracks in the land fade away.
And thus, a soul trapped for a thousand years dissipates.
All things will come to grow.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Laoshi?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It's raining?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: As I thought...
Like ink stains blending and blurring with water, the painting sealing this section of space gradually dissipates without a trace.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What just happened?!

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: You were so close...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Why you—

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Lord Zuo, I have no intention of becoming your enemy. However, I do hope you take what I said to heart.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: The days ahead of us are long, and there shall come a time when we meet again.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: In the end, this is how it turned out. Just like I said.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: My dear sister... These humans can't do anything without you.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: May you rest well now.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: When you next awaken, everything will be better.
